name: wildcard-excluded-single-label-tld-vs-unrelated-valid
description: excludedSubtrees dNSName is 'tld' (a single-label, TLD-shaped exclusion). The leaf's dNSName SAN is '*.example.com'. The wildcard's expansions are all of the form '<label>.example.com'; none of these equal 'tld' or fall within the 'tld' subtree. The exclusion does not apply and the leaf must be accepted.
references: Go #76935 — wildcard-exclusion strip-labels for single-label constraints over-matches
notes: The Go wildcard-exclusion backport to 1.24/1.25 stripped one label from both the excluded constraint and the wildcard's RHS to perform a parent-of-overlap check. For single-label exclusions ('tld'), stripping that one label leaves an empty string; the wildcard's RHS after one strip is also a multi-label tail. The buggy implementation could equate these, treating any wildcard SAN as overlapping with any single-label exclusion and erroneously rejecting unrelated wildcards.
Companion to wildcard-excluded-sibling-subtree-valid; both probe the same map-of-excluded-parents construction at different shape boundaries.
